audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].side all read "Skill" while the content layer reads Qiyana, Anivia, Qiyana, Anivia — four rows contradicting, including the level 6 flip itself.
audit.why: The packet chart matches the content layer exactly, including the first-item row going back to Qiyana: her lethality spike lets her all-in through a storm if she catches Anivia with Crystallize down.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side -> Qiyana, phases[4].side -> Anivia, phases[5].side -> Qiyana, phases[6].side -> Anivia.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text claims her first item lets her "clear your Frostbite stacks". Frostbite has no stacks — it is a 4-second single cast that doubles against a chilled target.
audit.why: Inventing a stack mechanic tells the player to protect something that does not exist. Her real first-item spike is a lethality item turning the Q-E-auto into a kill threshold.
audit.corrected: Restated against the real spike and the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect line says the matchup never names any of Qiyana's abilities. The full layer knows only "Audacity" and calls it "her stick dash" and "his sidestep tool". Terrashape, Elemental Wrath and Supreme Display of Talent are absent everywhere.
audit.why: She has two dashes, not one: Terrashape is a 1100-range dash on a flat 7 seconds and Audacity is a 650-range dash on 11s at rank 1. Advice built on one cooldown is wrong by half. Her R is a 950-range shockwave flagged knockup and hardCC, and Crystallize is terrain that can cut either dash.
audit.corrected: Named all four abilities with real cooldowns and separated the two dashes.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Commit on Audacity's cooldown" is the only window given, and it ignores Terrashape.
audit.why: Terrashape returns every 7 seconds regardless of rank, so Audacity being down does not mean she cannot reach you — it means she cannot reach you with a target-lock.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

notes: The packet defect was accurate: outside one mention of Audacity, none of Qiyana's abilities were named anywhere in the matchup. Two real errors fixed: (1) spikes[2].text invented "Frostbite stacks" — Frostbite is a single 4s cast that doubles on a chilled target, no stacks exist, and wants.foe[0] repeated the same invention; (2) the whole matchup treated Audacity as her only dash when Terrashape is a 1100-range dash on a flat 7s. I did NOT write the commonly-claimed interaction that Qiyana can Terrashape off Anivia's Crystallize to enchant her weapon — Riot's text for Terrashape only says she dashes to a location and enchants her weapon, and the kits do not establish whether player-created terrain qualifies. That question is in questionsForUser. content.early still contains the same "Frostbite stacks on cannon waves" phrasing; I left that paragraph alone rather than rewrite 400 characters around one clause. | COHERENCE: 2 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
